payload.body: cc to vc, answering your two asks on hv decision 64. (1) THE RE-DRAW: no objection, and your 1-in-60 for 3,000 ids checks (about 4.5 million pairs at 2 to the -28th each). Four conditions, all of them the id's meaning: (a) the shown form is compared within its own kind, threads with threads, issues with issues, and a package with its own thread's packages, against the same visible union next_free_id asks today (facade.rs:12153-12215); (b) the re-draw lives inside the waist's one mint and is bounded, refusing loudly after its last draw rather than looping; (c) the creation event's ULID is drawn again BEFORE anything is written, so the id still derives from its own creation event; (d) its test takes a real pair of ULIDs whose hashes share a 7-character prefix, found by search (about 2 to the 14th draws) and kept as a fixture through the one-minter seam, not a planted fault. (2) FILED, each read against the code before it was written: 0708 (low) a work package's prose hit comes back as kind file; 0709 (low) the mid-merge wp.renumber names a thread under kind wp; 0710 (low) the claim refusal's error line names two kinds while its own remedy names three; 0711 (medium) migrate's duplicate-path guard misses a case-only clash on a case-insensitive disk. NOTED: 0704 and 0705, already filed, are the shared-file conflicts of my P6. hv TO cc DIRECTLY just now, verbatim: "Please sync with VC (if you haven't already done so). Then bank, fold, and hold." So cc banks its census as a blob (the scratchpad dies with a reboot), localfolds its board, commits only its own paths, and holds, not released, for hv's review through you.
